chief_complaint: Advanced chronic kidney disease (stage 4) with pending kidney transplantation, complicated by diabetes, hypertension, and ischemic heart disease.
history_of_present_illness: The patient has a 40‑year history of type 2 diabetes mellitus complicated by progressive diabetic nephropathy. Renal function declined from CKD stage 1 in 1992 to stage 4 by 1999, with persistent proteinuria and microalbuminuria. Hypertension has been present since the late 1960s and is treated with an ACE inhibitor. Coronary artery disease manifested in the early 1990s, leading to CABG in 1991; she now experiences angina managed with metoprolol and nitroglycerin. Anemia has been chronic since 1980. Obesity, metabolic syndrome, and hypertriglyceridemia further increase cardiovascular risk. She is currently awaiting kidney transplantation. Social factors (limited contact, housing instability, stress) may affect adherence and follow‑up. No visits have been recorded after 2003, and many recent laboratory values are missing.
